description: Get an honest second opinion on a gift the user already has in mind: a verdict (great, good, risky or rethink), reasons it works, specific risks, 3 upgrades within the budget (an add-on, a better version or a swap) and a presentation tip, plus a giftgenius.io link that opens the verdict with where to buy each one. Pass the gift and every detail you already know about the recipient; gift, relationship, occasion and budget are required.

age.description: Recipient age in years, if known.

budget.description: Price per gift: under-25 (under $25), 25-50, 50-100, or 100-plus ($100+). Ideas come from this tier or cheaper.

gift.description: The gift the user is considering, in a few words, e.g. "an espresso machine" or "a Minecraft hoodie" (3-120 characters).

interests.description: Up to 8 short interests or hobbies, e.g. ["coffee", "gardening"]. An entry holding a comma-separated list is split into separate interests.

notes.description: Anything else that helps: personality, things they already own, what to avoid (max 400 characters).

occasion.description: The occasion. Use "Just because" if none fits.

relationship.description: Who the gift is for. Map husband/wife/boyfriend/girlfriend to "Partner", son/daughter to "Kid", brother/sister to "Sibling", grandma/grandpa to "Grandparent", colleague to "Coworker"; otherwise "Someone else".

name: check_gift_idea

check_url.description: The same check on giftgenius.io, pre-filled for the user to run or refine.

gift_name.description: Short product name for the gift the user is considering.

headline.description: One-sentence verdict addressed to the giver.

list_url.description: This verdict and its upgrades on giftgenius.io, with where to buy each.

presentation.description: How to give or wrap it so it feels personal.

kind.description: add-on: a companion item; better-version: a better take on the same idea; swap: a different gift that fits better.

title: Check a gift idea
